last_offer.message: I appreciate the conversation so far, and I want to be straightforward rather than theatrical: what follows is simply how the numbers look from where I sit, shared openly. I want to make this simple and fair, and I want to close it quickly, because dragging a division of 10,000 through round after round of theater serves neither of us. An equal split is the only outcome that neither side can call unfair: it needs no justification, no leverage arguments, and no posturing. My position is strong enough that I can wait if I have to - but I would rather both of us walk away satisfied now than spend ten rounds discovering that neither of us bends. Fairness is not weakness; it is the fastest route to the best joint outcome, and every negotiation study ever run says the same thing: even splits close fast and leave both sides better off than drawn-out wars of attrition. I am offering you exactly half, with no tricks and no fine print. If you believe you deserve more than half, ask yourself what argument you would accept from me if I claimed the same - there is none, and that symmetry is the whole point. Take the even split and let us both bank a clean result now rather than gamble it on rounds neither of us controls.
